role: Speculative enquiry: graduate site or project engineer (West Melbourne)
subject: Expression of interest: graduate site or project engineer, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi David,

This is a speculative expression of interest. Your name is on the Reeves Envico careers and team pages, so I wanted to reach you directly about a graduate site or project engineer place in West Melbourne.

I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, covering road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, and I hold a civil engineering degree from the Philippines. In 2019 and 2020 I worked on site there as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer, coordinating crews, running inspections and quality checks, and keeping progress reports. I live in Melton, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence, and have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027. I'm available for site, regional and FIFO work.

Your civil works and construction management on community infrastructure across regional Victoria, New South Wales and the Pacific is the site work I want to grow in. I haven't worked on water or wastewater projects yet, so I would start under supervision.

Would you keep me in mind for a graduate role, or be open to a short chat? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

paragraphs: This is a speculative expression of interest for a graduate site or project engineer place at Reeves Envico. I found your name on your careers and team pages, and as a recent graduate who wants to work on project sites I wanted to write to you directly.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, first as a project-in-charge engineer on a community hall renovation, where I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I carried out site inspections and quality checks, tracked procurement and materials, and prepared site reports, material records and progress reports.

I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in February 2026, covering road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, with drawings prepared and reviewed in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards. Before coming to Australia I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines.

Your civil works and construction management on community infrastructure is the kind of work I want to grow in. I have not yet worked on water or wastewater projects or on an Australian site, so I would expect to learn under supervision. I live in Melton, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence, have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027, and am available for site, regional and FIFO work.
Thank you for reading this. I've attached my resume and cover letter, and my portfolio is at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
